key_facts.fact: Per-contact memory needs one call, not a sample; VP may claim 'remembers every customer, shows where calls fail, proves the changes you approve' but not 'learns on its own from every call' below ~1,000 calls/day on one script.

A line that doubles the hang-up hazard is flagged with probability 0.19 / 0.67 / 0.94 at 100 / 500 / 1,000 calls (false flags <=2.6%); a fix is proved with ~592 calls/arm on the local hazard vs 4,028 on completion vs 25,963 on conversion.
key_facts.evidence: l6 report s.4.8; verify.md item 6 (weakened 'hundreds' to >=500)

key_facts.fact: Outcome tests are expensive: 20%->22% (+10% rel) needs 6,510 connected calls per arm; 20%->25% needs 1,094; 10%->11% needs 14,751.

Daily-checked 'winner at P(best)>=0.95' dashboards declare false winners in A/A by day 90 at ~52-62% with K=2 (the split every vendor ships), ~20-24% at K=3, ~4-14% at K=4; naive daily z-test 16% by day 7, 36-37% by day 90.
key_facts.evidence: l6 verify.md item 4; l6 report L03; rejected.2026-10-17.k2-dashboards

key_facts.fact: Thompson sampling at 1,000 calls/day picks the right of 4 variants (+10% rel on 20%) 86% by day 7 and 99% by day 30 with 0.9% regret; at 100/day only 49/72/91% by day 7/30/90 and 29% declare by day 90.
key_facts.evidence: l6 report s.4.3 (400 runs per config), verify item 3 confirmed

key_facts.fact: After a best-arm switch at day 60, plain Thompson still picked the old winner on day 90 in 56% of runs; discounted (gamma 0.97) and 21-day window reached 0.985/0.983 correct; novelty variants were falsely declared in 82% of Thompson runs.
One segment policy pooled across dissimilar tenants handed the wrong winner to 48-55% of tenants; partial pooling cut A/A false winners from ~21% to 2.5%.

An LLM outcome label at 90% accuracy inflates required calls 1.8-2.4x (80%: 3.6-5.5x); a judge 3 points biased to one variant 'finds' it better in 57.5% of A/A tests; our judge failures were on preference judging, not outcome extraction.

Extra power numbers for learnable targets: early hang-up 15%->10% needs 686 calls/arm, 15%->12% needs 2,036; connect rate 50%->55% needs 1,565 dials/arm, 30%->36% needs 963; cut-in 25%->18% needs 540 turns/arm unclustered, ~70-165 calls/arm at 8-12 turns/call with ICC 0.05-0.2 (ICC assumed).
key_facts.evidence: this step, same two-proportion formula as l6 power.py (reproduces 1,565 for 50->45); data/blueprint/learning-memory-omnichannel.json

key_facts.fact: Retell contact memory is one rewritten text brief of at most 2,000 characters per phone number; dashboard default read ON, save OFF at USD 0.005 per memory run; web calls don't save.

ElevenLabs user memory is built but gated (403 'User memories are not available for this workspace'), with a Memory (Alpha) tab now visible in the dashboard; widget user_id defaults to a browser fingerprint (device-keyed).

Bolna, Sarvam, Vapi and Exotel have no cross-call memory; SquadStack markets Persistent Memory and Lift but its code shows intra-call memory only; Synthflow injects per-contact summaries keyed by phone across voice, SMS and WhatsApp.
Every competitor learning loop is human-gated with no documented statistics, except Vapi Composer's 'Bypass approvals' mode (2026-09-28) and Bland's autonomous Tornado test-fix loop.
key_facts.evidence: teardown SYNTHESIS l.363; evidence.2026-10-20.vapi-v2-loop; l6 verify.md item 7

key_facts.fact: harness2 (arXiv 2610.14224, 2026-10-09) optimises 8 harness components with fixed weights via Propose-Probe-Compose (invariant + domain candidates, behavioural contrasts with no ground truth, composer must cite observations) plus a lesson library kept only on contrast evidence; single-step gains up to +11.5 (WorkBuddy), +4.5 (JobBench), +11.8 pp (LAB); removing the library costs 3.1/1.8 points.

harness2 reports its own limits: contrast evidence is noisy and shares model bias, gains are non-monotonic in k, 9 regressions from poor selection (one 54->26), propagated false premises (-2 to -11) and noise; it discusses no human-in-the-loop and no production deployment.
Our own raw-fact memory (store whatever the call said) accumulated brief facts, contradictions and gender errors and re-injected them each call; replaced by preference-only memory.

Inherited memory: recall@8 went 73.9% -> 95.7%; consolidation costs ~USD 0.0007 per person per night; lexical-only recall failed 0/27 adversarial cases; the only live preference trial stored Hindi and replied entirely in English.
key_facts.evidence: docs/harvest/hp-main.md l.217; docs/harvest/SYNTHESIS.md l.109, l.240-241; docs/harvest/hp-handoffs.md l.36

key_facts.fact: Retell's CRM stored '9000000001' as +19000000001 and kept '+919000000003' and '09000000003' as two contacts, so messy Indian lists yield wrong-country numbers and duplicates.

VP already has offline-tested exact-quote learning: proposals must cite an exact caller quote and span, re-checked in the commit transaction; anonymous or unverified channel senders are feedback-only; opt-in autoLearning is frozen per deployment revision with 25/day per deployment and 100/day per workspace caps.

Customer-specific context lifts outcomes in field experiments (goal-specific reminders +16% savings; name in subject +31% leads; two-way bank-agent call +34.4 pp timely repayment, n=3,448), but no rigorous study exists for AI voice with CRM context.
Meta terms s.4.7: WhatsApp Platform Data may not train or improve AI except a model for the business's exclusive use, so WhatsApp data can never feed cross-tenant learning.

DPDP Rules Gazette dated 2025-11-13: consent managers from ~2026-11-13, core obligations ~2027-05-13; Rule 3 notice itemised with withdraw link; Rule 6 one-year log retention and processor-contract safeguards; no general localisation, but IRDAI records stay in India for >=10 years.

Service calls to existing customers rest on DPDP s.7(a) and TCCCPR inferred consent for the contract's life; pre-sale needs inquiry (7 days) or application (3 months) evidence; DND needs CRF consent that only 11 pilot banks can upload.

Number series cannot pick a dialect (MNP keeps the series; Bihar LSA ~1.35%/month porting) and LID labelled only 2 of 6 Bhojpuri clips correctly, so dialect matching must be opt-in or stated, not inferred.

TRAI reg 21A: telco AI flags 10-digit CLIs with short calls and high recipient diversity; 5 flags in 10 days trigger KYC re-verification and a 15-day bar (140/1600/1601 exempt), so any exploration must stop if the early hang-up ratio per CLI rises.
Trusting a model-emitted marker to delete caused 44 irrecoverably deleted rows; deletion and outbound actions must be triggered by verified human intent checked in code.

requirements.requirement: Learning runs as measure-in-code, then Propose-Probe-Compose offline, then code gates, then one-click human approval, then a fixed-horizon online proof, then expiry. No autonomous publish mode.
Show the A/A status, a power meter, an 'under-powered' verdict and winner expiry on every experiment. Report effects with intervals from held-out or AIPW read-outs.
Line-level hang-up hazard comes from TTS clause timestamps aligned with telephony hang-ups. This needs clause events from the production telephony path.

Locked sections (disclosure, recording notice, consent and opt-out, crisis lines, identity, prices and offers, category fence, appended-last rules) cannot be edited by any learner. This is enforced by an empty-diff check in code.

Thompson sampling is opt-in only, for tenants at 1,000 or more calls/day on one script with an outcome delay of 7 days or less. It is discounted or windowed, keeps an exploration floor, and stops on a rise in early hang-ups per CLI.

Memory is a ledger of Facts. Each Fact has an exact caller quote, episode and span, a purpose, a consent record and an authority rank. It is compiled per call into a bounded, purpose-matched brief, and contradictions are stored as new rows.
A live multi-call adherence test (language, opt-out, promise recall) gates memory release. Kill if recall is below 95% or preferences are ignored more than 1 time in 20.

Every source (CSV, CRM, telephony, WhatsApp, SMS, email, web/app, payment, policy systems) lands as immutable receipts, Episodes and Facts with provenance. Identity merges use exact match only, and conflicts go to review.
Outcomes are written back from CRM, payment and booking systems as code-earned outcomes and leading indicators.

Forget follows the person across channels, writes a tombstone so re-imports cannot resurrect the data, and is triggered only by verified intent checked in code. Retention is set per class (recording, transcript, facts, logs, aggregates), with sector overrides.
No cross-tenant pooling of personal data or WhatsApp data. Segment priors use aggregate counts only, under each tenant's contract, from v1.5.
